Subject: MSA + Security exhibit scoping

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Legal and InfoSec at Novamed asked me to send over a short list of questions so we can align the Security Exhibit in the MSA and lock the Order Form. Two immediate asks from our side: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: we need confirmation on when Redwood can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and whether you can provide quarterly evidence snapshots for the first 12 months.
2) Pen test language + access: Novamed prefers a clause allowing an annual pen test with on-site capability if needed, and explicit language about forensic access during incident-led inspections.

I've attached a short spreadsheet (SOC2-questions.xlsx) with the initial evidence items our auditors will look for. Can you confirm your target cadence for responding to evidence requests and whether the pen-test window below is feasible?

Suggested pen-test window: Feb 8-12, 2026 (we can narrow to specific days once scope is agreed).

We'd like to close MSA + Order Form by end of February. Please loop in Legal and Security on your side.

Thanks,
Erin Patel
Sr. Information Security Manager
Novamed

Attachments: SOC2-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet of requested artifacts)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Patel <erin.patel@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit scoping

Erin — thanks for the clarity and the spreadsheet. Looping in Karthik (Legal) and Laura (Security) to weigh in on the redlines. Quick replies to your two asks below and a proposed next step list.

SOC 2 evidence: we can provide a copy of our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA within 2 business days of signature. For the "quarterly snapshots" ask: we normally operate on an annual attestation cadence plus targeted artifact pulls. That said, we can commit to monthly/quarterly artifact snapshots for a defined set of controls for the first 12 months if we map the exact artifacts up front (saves both teams time).

Pen test language & access: proposed compromise: annual pen test with scoped on-site only if the test requires it (and with mutually agreed playbook). Forensic access: we are sensitive to unlimited or broad forensic clauses; we can offer a scoped forensics access procedure (NDA + JIT access window + read-only copies where feasible).

Proposed timeline & next steps:
- Karthik to produce a short redline deck for the Security Exhibit and a suggested order form amendment (timeline: 48 hours).
- Laura to propose the minimal artifact set for quarterly snapshots.
- Tentative pen-test canary dates: Feb 10-12, 2026 (we can compress to 1-2 days after scope finalization).
- 30-min legal call to finalize redlines: can you do Tues 1/20 or Wed 1/21?

Attaching our initial redlined MSA for your review (redlined_MSA_v3.docx) — high level notes in the doc. Markus — can you keep sales/contracting in the loop on timing and any discount/term implications?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Go-to-Market Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlined_MSA_v3.docx (redline with inline comments)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit scoping — legal redline notes

Jordan/Team — I reviewed Erin's spreadsheet and Jordan's redlines. Key legal positions we should push back on and suggested wording: 

1) Forensic access: remove any language implying "unlimited forensic access." Replace with: "Customer may request forensic artifacts limited to the scope of the incident; Redwood will provide agreed-upon artifacts or remote access within an agreed timeframe, subject to Redwood's operational constraints and redaction for third-party data."

2) Pen-test frequency: push to annual with explicit negotiated scope. If Novamed needs more frequent testing, propose a paid add-on or a limited one-off at cost.

3) Evidence cadence: counter-propose defined control set for "quarterly snapshots" — Annex A to enumerate artifacts (hosts, configuration extracts, authentication logs for service accounts). Avoid open-ended language such as "full access to all logs."

4) On-site inspections: accept only for critical regulatory needs, and require a scoped scope-of-work and short notice (14–30 days), plus an inspection playbook to be agreed.

I'm attaching an order form amendment draft that codifies the above (orderform_amend_draft.docx). If Novamed insists on quarterly full evidence deliveries, we should capture operational lead times and potential fee implications in the Order Form.

Jordan — recommend the 30-min call to get alignment; I'll draft talking points.

—Karthik
General Counsel (Contracts)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: orderform_amend_draft.docx (proposed contract language)

From: Erin Patel <erin.patel@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Gardner <tim.gardner@novamed.com>, legal@novamed.com
Date: 2026-01-19T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit scoping — Novamed position

Jordan/Karthik — appreciate the quick review. A couple of points from Novamed InfoSec/legal: 

• SOC2: We need the Type II report pre-signature. We can do a redacted copy if necessary.
• Quarterly snapshots: Novamed is willing to limit the quarterly asks to a named set of artifacts (we provided an initial list in the spreadsheet). That said, for the first 12 months we need a commitment to quarterly artifact deliveries (remote extracts) for SOC-relevant controls — we view this as a risk-reduction measure for an early-stage vendor relationship.
• Pen tests/on-site: We will accept annual pen tests, but we require the Order Form to state that Novamed can request an additional on-site test following a material incident.
• Forensic access: we will sign an NDA and accept the scoped, limited forensic access approach so long as language guarantees access within 48 hours of a regulatory or incident-led request.

If we can get agreement on the above, legal will push the Order Form toward signature. I've routed a short DocuSign for the latest Order Form draft for internal pre-signature review (link below).

DocuSign (for internal pre-sign): https://docusign.com/novamed-msapath/12345

We can do Wed 1/21 09:00 or Thu 1/22 14:00 PT for the legal sync — Wed works best for Tim and our counsel.

Thanks —
Erin
